q1_issues.issue: `(PartOf lloyd_mcclendon pirates)` — a proper noun premodifying a common-noun head ("Pirates manager") takes the opaque `Possession`, and the rule explicitly bars inventing membership or `PartOf` the words do not state; `pirates` is moreover a `Name`-only plural-label individual with no `GroupOf`, so nothing establishes it as a group to be a part of.

"We" is resolved to `pirates`; the coreference rules cover he/she/it/they only and give a pronoun with no antecedent a fresh witness, so binding the quote's first-person subject to the team is a world-knowledge link the text does not state.

`(Member $p quality)` predicates the noun modifier "quality" of each player as a property class; the compound rules treat a noun modifier as never exposable, so "quality players" should either fuse (`quality_player` + genus `player`) or the modifier stays in the symbol.

q2_gaps: first- and second-person pronouns ("we", "I", "you") inside a direct quotation — the Coreference & anaphora section supplies antecedent and fallback-witness rules only for third-person he/she/it/they
notes: The quotation routing is otherwise right: sealed under `Theme` of a `say` event with `Experiencer` holder, `Past` on the matrix only, the sealed plural's per-member `Implication` correctly placed INSIDE the seal with its own variable, the indefinite player group left sealed, and the occupational premodifier correctly wrapped by the past host clause as `(Past (Member lloyd_mcclendon manager))` and kept out of the `Name` string.
